targets.text: Sungard – Senior Project Manager | January 2016 – April 2019
❖ Delivered end-to-end payment platforms using ISO 8583 and ISO 20022 standards, enabling secure, scalable, and high-volume transaction
processing systems.
❖ Managed cross-border and domestic payment flows including SWIFT (MT103, MT202) and SEPA (pain.001, pacs.008), ensuring compliance,
accuracy, and seamless settlement.
❖ Applied Agile planning, bottom-up estimation, and resource forecasting to ensure predictable delivery timelines and optimal utilization of
project resources.
❖ Collaborated with engineering and API teams to ensure seamless integration and orchestration of payment transactions across enterprise
systems and gateways.
❖ Resolved complex payment failures including duplicates, timeouts, and formatting errors, improving system reliability and transaction
success rates.
❖ Strong exposure to API-level integrations, including REST API coordination, Swagger/API documentation review, request-response
validation, integration testing support, defect triaging, and end-to-end system integration management.
❖ Experience collaborating with Development, QA, Product Owners, HR teams, and business stakeholders to drive project execution, resource
planning, defect management, and delivery governance.
Telefonica – Defect Manager / Test Architect | December 2014 – December 2015
❖ Led end-to-end defect lifecycle management across mobile (2G–5G) and enterprise systems ensuring structured tracking, prioritization, and
timely resolution of critical issues.
❖ Supported product enhancements across claims, payments, authorization workflows, and benefits systems ensuring smooth delivery of
customer-facing features.
❖ Managed Agile backlog, roadmap, and release planning using Jira and Confluence to ensure transparency, governance, and delivery
alignment.
❖ Collaborated with UX, QA, engineering, and business teams to ensure requirement clarity, design validation, and synchronized execution of
releases.
Identified risks and delivery bottlenecks proactively and implemented mitigation strategies to ensure on-time and quality-driven delivery
outcomes.
❖ Quick learner with the ability to adapt to new domains, understand complex business workflows, stakeholder expectations, compliance
requirements, and drive successful project outcomes in Agile environments.
Datamatics – Test Lead | August 2008 – November 2014
❖ Defined comprehensive test strategies covering functional, regression, integration, and system testing ensuring high-quality delivery
aligned with business requirements.
❖ Led end-to-end testing activities for healthcare insurance applications, including policy administration, member enrollment, claims
processing, provider management, and customer portals.
❖ Managed a team of 8–12 QA engineers across onsite and offshore locations, ensuring timely delivery of testing milestones.
❖ Developed test strategies, test plans, test scenarios, and test cases based on business requirements and functional specifications.
❖ Coordinated Functional, System Integration (SIT), Regression, User Acceptance (UAT), and End-to-End testing across multiple releases.
❖ Collaborated with business analysts, developers, product owners, and stakeholders to clarify requirements and resolve production issues.
❖ Managed defect lifecycle using Jira/ALM, conducted defect triage meetings, and ensured timely resolution of critical issues.
❖ Automated regression test suites using Selenium WebDriver and integrated automated execution into CI/CD pipelines where applicable.
❖ Validated REST/SOAP APIs using Postman and SOAP UI and performed backend database validation using SQL.
❖ Generated daily status reports, quality metrics, test execution dashboards, and release readiness reports for senior management.
❖ Mentored QA team members on testing best practices, Agile processes, and quality standards.
Implemented risk-based testing approaches to improve test coverage while reducing execution time.
Improved release quality by reducing production defects through proactive risk identification, root cause analysis, and continuous process
improvements
